tasks.label: postgres: up
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; docker info *> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $dockerDesktop = 'C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\Docker Desktop.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dockerDesktop)) { throw 'Docker Desktop не установлен.' }; Start-Process -FilePath $dockerDesktop -WindowStyle Hidden; $dockerReady = $false; for ($attempt = 0; $attempt -lt 30; $attempt++) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; docker info *> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $dockerReady = $true; break } }; if (-not $dockerReady) { throw 'Docker Desktop не запустился за 60 секунд.' } }; docker compose up -d postgres; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $postgresReady = $false; for ($attempt = 0; $attempt -lt 30; $attempt++) { $status = docker inspect --format '{{.State.Health.Status}}' funpay-postgres 2>$null; if ($status -eq 'healthy') { $postgresReady = $true; break }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 }; if (-not $postgresReady) { throw 'PostgreSQL проекта не стала готова за 60 секунд.' }; Write-Host 'PostgreSQL готова: localhost:5435'

tasks.label: frontend: dev
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; try { Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:5173' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 1 | Out-Null; Write-Host 'Local: http://localhost:5173/'; while ($true) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 3600 } } catch { npm run dev -- --host localhost --clearScreen false }
